build_face_dataset: build a FaceDataset instance to load face segmentation images and labels from a directory
load_face_data_list: load all face image and segmentation mask pairs from the data root directory
get_face_data_info: get the image and ground truth segmentation map for a given sample index
review_face_classes: review the 20 face part segmentation classes including skin, eyes, nose, lips, and hair
review_face_palette: review the RGB color palette mapping for each of the 20 face segmentation classes
